##### Project general facts

Uptown Dubai Residences is an exceptional branded residential development located within the iconic Uptown Tower, bringing together contemporary architecture, French-inspired elegance, and world-class hospitality. Designed in collaboration with internationally renowned architects and designers, the project offers an exclusive collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments, duplexes, and penthouses with breathtaking panoramic views of Dubai’s skyline, Dubai Marina, Ain Dubai, and the Arabian Gulf. Every residence reflects a sophisticated blend of modern design, premium comfort, and timeless style, creating a truly elevated urban living experience.

Residents enjoy a lifestyle defined by luxury, convenience, and five-star services inspired by the renowned SO/ brand. Positioned in one of Dubai’s most prestigious districts, the development provides seamless access to business hubs, fine dining, retail, entertainment, and waterfront attractions. A carefully curated selection of premium amenities and hotel-style services creates an exclusive environment where every detail is designed to enhance everyday living and deliver an exceptional residential experience.

The residences feature elegant contemporary interiors finished with high-quality materials, including porcelain flooring, engineered stone countertops, custom lacquered cabinetry, and refined metal accents throughout the living spaces. Kitchens come fully equipped with premium built-in appliances, including a refrigerator, freezer, oven, gas hob, exhaust hood, dishwasher, microwave, and sink. The residences are delivered unfurnished, allowing homeowners to personalize their interiors while enjoying the highest standards of design and craftsmanship.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Heights is a luxurious residential district nestled in the heart of Dubai, known for its picturesque surroundings and upscale living. This vibrant community offers a mix of low-rise apartment buildings and townhouses, all designed with modern aesthetics and contemporary architecture. The district's highlight is its tranquil and serene atmosphere, with beautifully landscaped gardens, water features, and tree-lined streets, creating an oasis of calm amidst the bustling city.

One of the distinguishing features of Jumeirah Heights is its convenient location, providing residents with easy access to Dubai's key attractions. The community is situated close to popular destinations such as Dubai Marina, JBR Beach, and the vibrant Dubai Media City, making it a prime choice for those seeking a cosmopolitan lifestyle. Additionally, Jumeirah Heights boasts a range of top-notch amenities, including fitness centers, swimming pools, and a variety of dining and retail options, ensuring that residents have all they need right at their doorstep.

The district's residential units are known for their spacious interiors and modern finishes, catering to the discerning tastes of its residents. Whether you're looking for a stylish apartment with stunning city views or a comfortable townhouse with a private garden, Jumeirah Heights offers a range of housing options to suit various preferences. Overall, Jumeirah Heights stands as an exclusive residential haven in Dubai, combining luxury living with accessibility and natural beauty.
